subject: Video captions
body:
Caption review handover

The dark strip works better than larger bold text. Please preserve Jana's punctuation edits instead of regenerating captions over them. Ben would like the learning-journal mistake kept as a classroom example, separate from the published version.

Yara has asked for a direct contact for appearance concerns. Mira and Rafael have flagged paperwork at the edge of frames. Those crops are small changes, not requests to reshoot everything.

Leo's staged bedsheet post should be labelled where a person forwarding the thumbnail will notice. The joke is fine; making it look like an unlabelled report just creates avoidable questions. Hanna
